author: reek
body: The second route: induction over the BUILTIN List. The induction checker resolves `xs : List a` to a synthesized Nil/Cons view, and the proof normalizer reduces the builtin primitives (list-length, list-push, list-snoc, list-at) over Nil/Cons spines. Before this, every such claim was accepted as an unproven axiom with CDX4022; this file must compile with ZERO CDX4022 and zero errors, and the negative guards live in codex/test/errors/list-induction-false and codex/test/errors/list-prim-false, where a false claim over the same shapes must be a hard error.

author: reek
body: Ground claims with no induction, each discharged by Refl only because the normalizer actually reduces the primitive: at 0 is the head, at 1 recurses into the tail, and push walks to the end.

author: reek
body: A later pass carried the remaining three primitives here. Each ground claim below is discharged by Refl only because its rule fires; without the rule the spine stays stuck and the claim is a CDX2001 mismatch, which is what makes these a test rather than a decoration.

author: reek
body: The proofs erase at emit, so the runtime line is what the battery can see; the compile-time content is the zero-CDX4022 requirement above.
